train_prm_model: train a process reward model using the PRMTrainer with a model and dataset from Hugging Face
run_prm_training_cli: run PRM training CLI with model_name_or_path, dataset_name, output_dir, and learning_rate arguments
run_lora_prm_training: run LoRA-based PRM training with use_peft, lora_r, lora_alpha, and lora_task_type TOKEN_CLS arguments
evaluate_prm_model: evaluate a trained PRM model and log evaluation metrics to trackio
save_and_push_prm_model: save a trained PRM model to a local output directory and push it to the Hugging Face Hub
